title: Solving camera pose and intrinsics from face images

queue.claim: EXIF FocalLengthIn35mmFilm is defined on the image diagonal, so Blender lens = f35 × 1.040 for 4:3, × 0.955 for 16:9 and × 1.177 for 1:1 (sensor 36 mm, long-side fit). Typing EXIF f35 directly into Blender is 4–18% off. The engine's focal_px_from_35mm assumes the diagonal convention.
queue.query: Exif FocalLengthIn35mmFilm definition diagonal or width equivalent focal length CIPA DC-008

queue.claim: Adult interpupillary distance has a mean of about 63 mm with SD about 3.5–4 mm (Dodgson 2004). Used as the default global-scale prior.
queue.query: Dodgson 2004 variation and extrema of human interpupillary distance mean standard deviation adults

queue.claim: Modern automatic 68-point face landmark detectors reach a normalised mean error of about 3–4% of interocular distance on 300W. Used to set the landmark noise default σ_px = 0.025·IOD_px and the 2–3% IOD rule for accepting or rejecting a view.
queue.query: 300W normalized mean error inter-ocular state of the art face alignment HRNet NME 300W full set

queue.claim: The horizontal visible iris diameter is about 11.7 ± 0.5 mm across adults, as used by MediaPipe Iris for metric distance estimation.
queue.query: MediaPipe Iris horizontal iris diameter 11.7 mm depth estimation without depth sensor
